INSERT INTO market_info ( exchange, market, korean_name, english_name, market_warning, event_warning, event_caution ) VALUES
( #{market.exchange}, #{market.market}, #{market.koreanName}, #{market.englishName}, #{market.marketWarning}, #{market.eventWarning}, #{market.eventCaution} )
